$schema.description: JSON schema reference for configuration validation

shell.description: Default shell to use for terminal and shell tool execution

model.description: Model to use in the format of provider/model, eg anthropic/claude-2

default_agent.description: Default primary agent to use when no session agent is selected

update.description: Disable updates, notify when one is available, or install updates automatically

share.description: Control whether sessions may be shared manually, automatically, or not at all

username.description: Username displayed in conversations and used for telemetry identity

policies.description: Ordered policies controlling access to providers, tools, and integrations

agents.description: Named built-in agent overrides and custom agent definitions

snapshots.description: Enable snapshots used for undo and revert behavior

formatter.description: Enable built-in formatters or configure formatter overrides

lsp.description: Enable built-in language servers or configure server overrides

max_lines.description: Maximum lines of tool output before it is truncated and saved to disk (default: 2000)

max_bytes.description: Maximum bytes of tool output before it is truncated and saved to disk (default: 51200)

tool_output.description: Thresholds for truncating tool output. When output exceeds either limit, the full text is written to the truncation directory and a preview is returned.

startup.description: Maximum time in milliseconds to establish and initialize the MCP server.

catalog.description: Maximum time in milliseconds to wait for MCP discovery requests such as tools/list and prompts/list.

execution.description: Maximum time in milliseconds to wait for MCP tool and prompt execution.

auto.description: Enable automatic compaction when context is full (default: true)

prune.description: Enable pruning of old tool outputs (default: false)

tail_turns.description: Maximum number of recent user turns, including their following assistant/tool responses, to keep verbatim during compaction. By default retention is limited only by the preserved token budget.

preserve_recent_tokens.description: Maximum number of tokens from recent turns to preserve verbatim after compaction

reserved.description: Token buffer for compaction. Leaves enough window to avoid overflow during compaction.

skills.description: Additional paths or URLs to discover skills from

anyOf.description: Additional paths or URLs to discover skills from

urls.description: URLs to fetch skills from (e.g., https://example.com/.well-known/skills/)

instructions.description: Additional paths or URLs supplying ambient instructions

references.description: Named local directories or Git repositories available as external context

plugins.description: Ordered plugin enablement directives and external package declarations

warming.description: Keep recently active sessions warm with transient model requests (default: false)

presets.description: Topic presets: name to template, overriding or extending the built-in presets

vars.description: Template variables: name to value or template, overriding or extending the built-in variables

session_start.description: Template added to every session's instructions when it starts (default: the current date, time and timezone). An empty string disables it

user.description: Whether the root session sees messages sent to the user (default: "visible")

match.description: Default match mode for message and log searches (default: "hybrid")

model.description: Fast model (provider/model) that reranks advanced searches; defaults to the session provider's small model

embedding.description: Local embedding model: a tier name ("tiny", "default", "step-up", "top", "off") or detailed settings

providers.description: Provider aliases mapping alias -> providerID, e.g. { ds: 'deepseek' }

models.description: Model aliases. Bare key = global alias -> provider/model[#variant]. Scoped key = provider/key -> model[#variant].

variants.description: Variant/effort aliases. Keys can be bare 'alias', or 'provider/*#alias', '*/model#alias', or 'provider/model#alias'.

providers.description: Provider aliases mapping alias -> providerID, e.g. { ds: 'deepseek' }

models.description: Model aliases. Bare key = global alias -> provider/model[#variant]. Scoped key = provider/key -> model[#variant].

variants.description: Variant/effort aliases. Keys can be bare 'alias', or 'provider/*#alias', '*/model#alias', or 'provider/model#alias'.

portable_shell_scanner.description: Enable the experimental portable shell permission scanner. Defaults to false.

subagent_depth.description: Maximum subagent nesting depth below a top-level session. 0 disables subagents and 1 stops subagents from launching their own. Defaults to 5.

shell_timeout.description: Default timeout in milliseconds for foreground shell commands. 0 disables the timeout. Defaults to 120000.

policies.description: Policy statements applied to supported resources, such as provider access

model_route_schedules.description: Time-bound weight changes across routes: during a local-time window, matching provider/model targets are ranked higher or lower (or given a fixed weight) on every route they appear on. Weights order every selection mode; equal weights keep their configured order.

enabled.description: Review routing history on a schedule and put the resulting adjustments in force without asking, for every route that uses rules as well as those at adaptive or higher. They only lower a target's share or skip it, and lapse on their own. Defaults to false.

windowHours.description: How much history each review looks at. Defaults to 24.

notes.description: What the history cannot say, one note per line as `match: text`, where `match` is a case-insensitive substring of provider/model. A text that states when a limit returns, such as `reset at 2026-01-01` or `back in 3 hours`, skips the matching targets until then. The rest is shown to the agent by route_stats.

captureErrorBodies.description: Keep the first 2 KB of a failed request's error body in the routing history, with credentials redacted. A provider body can echo the request, so this is off by default. Defaults to false.

openTelemetry.description: Enable OpenTelemetry spans for AI SDK calls (using the 'experimental_telemetry' flag)

primary_tools.description: Tools that should only be available to primary agents.

continue_loop_on_deny.description: Continue the agent loop when a tool call is denied

mcp_timeout.description: Timeout in milliseconds for model context protocol (MCP) requests

server.description: Server configuration for opencode serve and web commands

reference.description: @deprecated Use 'references' field instead. Named git or local directory references

snapshot.description: Enable or disable snapshot tracking. When false, filesystem snapshots are not recorded and undoing or reverting will not undo/redo file changes. Defaults to true.

autoshare.description: @deprecated Use 'share' field instead. Share newly created sessions automatically

autoupdate.description: Check for new versions and show an update notice. Updates are never installed automatically; run /update or `opencode upgrade`. Set to false to disable update checks. true and 'notify' behave the same

disabled_providers.description: Disable providers that are loaded automatically

enabled_providers.description: When set, ONLY these providers will be enabled. All other providers will be ignored

small_model.description: Small model to use for tasks like title generation in the format of provider/model

subagent_depth.description: Maximum subagent nesting depth. Defaults to 1, which prevents subagents from launching subagents.

provider.description: Custom provider configurations and model overrides

attachment.description: Attachment processing configuration, including image size limits and resizing behavior

mdnsDomain.description: Custom domain name for mDNS service (default: opencode.local)

cors.description: Additional domains to allow for CORS

variant.description: Default model variant for this agent (applies only when using the agent's configured model).

description.description: Description of when to use the agent

hidden.description: Hide this subagent from the @ autocomplete menu (default: false, only applies to mode: subagent)

color.description: Hex color code (e.g., #FF5733) or theme color (e.g., primary)

steps.description: Maximum number of agentic iterations before forcing text-only response

enterpriseUrl.description: GitHub Enterprise URL for copilot authentication

setCacheKey.description: Enable promptCacheKey for this provider (default false)

timeout.description: Timeout in milliseconds for full requests to this provider. Set to false to disable timeout.

headerTimeout.description: Timeout in milliseconds to wait for response headers (default: 300000). Set to false to disable timeout.

chunkTimeout.description: Timeout in milliseconds between streamed SSE chunks for this provider (default: 300000). If no chunk arrives within this window, the request is aborted. Set to false to disable timeout.

disabled.description: Disable this variant for the model

command.description: Command and arguments to run the MCP server

cwd.description: Working directory for the MCP server process. Relative paths resolve from the workspace directory.

environment.description: Environment variables to set when running the MCP server

enabled.description: Enable or disable the MCP server on startup

timeout.description: Timeout in ms for MCP server requests. Defaults to 5000 (5 seconds) if not specified.

clientId.description: OAuth client ID. If not provided, dynamic client registration (RFC 7591) will be attempted.

clientSecret.description: OAuth client secret (if required by the authorization server)

scope.description: OAuth scopes to request during authorization

callbackPort.description: Port for the local OAuth callback server (default: 19876). Shorthand for redirectUri when only the port needs changing. Ignored if redirectUri is set.

url.description: URL of the remote MCP server

enabled.description: Enable or disable the MCP server on startup

headers.description: Headers to send with the request

oauth.description: OAuth authentication configuration for the MCP server. Set to false to disable OAuth auto-detection.

timeout.description: Timeout in ms for MCP server requests. Defaults to 5000 (5 seconds) if not specified.

auto_resize.description: Resize images before sending them to the model when they exceed configured limits (default: true)

max_width.description: Maximum image width before resizing or rejecting the attachment (default: 2000)

max_height.description: Maximum image height before resizing or rejecting the attachment (default: 2000)

max_base64_bytes.description: Maximum base64 payload bytes for an image attachment (default: 5242880)

Permission.Ruleset.description: Ordered tool permission rules applied to agent tool use

Mcp.Protocol.description: MCP protocol negotiation. "legacy" (default) opens with the initialize handshake and speaks protocol revisions up to 2025-11-25. "auto" probes for the 2026-07-28 revision and falls back to legacy when the server does not support it. "2026-07-28" requires that revision and fails otherwise.

cwd.description: Working directory for the MCP server process. Relative paths resolve from the workspace directory.

codemode.description: Expose this server's tools through Code Mode. Defaults to true.

startup.description: Maximum time in milliseconds to establish and initialize the MCP server.

catalog.description: Maximum time in milliseconds to wait for MCP discovery requests such as tools/list and prompts/list.

execution.description: Maximum time in milliseconds to wait for MCP tool and prompt execution.

auth_server_metadata_url.description: URL of the OAuth or OpenID Connect authorization server metadata document. Set when the MCP server does not publish protected resource metadata that names its authorization server.

codemode.description: Expose this server's tools through Code Mode. Defaults to true.

startup.description: Maximum time in milliseconds to establish and initialize the MCP server.

catalog.description: Maximum time in milliseconds to wait for MCP discovery requests such as tools/list and prompts/list.

execution.description: Maximum time in milliseconds to wait for MCP tool and prompt execution.

anyOf.description: Reuse a randomly selected provider until it is rate limited, then switch to another available provider.

Config.Worktree.description: Directory defaults for local worktree creation

url.description: GGUF download URL used instead of the tier's model

path.description: Existing local GGUF file used instead of downloading

pooling.description: Pooling override (default: the tier's pooling; for a custom model, last for Qwen3 embedding files and mean otherwise)

query.description: Instruction prefix for search queries, replacing the tier's prefix; the remote endpoint uses it too

server.description: llama-server executable to use instead of the downloaded llama.cpp build

autostart.description: Download and start the model in the background at startup (default: true)

gpu_layers.description: Layers to offload to the GPU (default: all)

url.description: Base URL of an OpenAI-compatible API, for example https://api.openai.com/v1

key.description: API key; {env:NAME} reads it from the environment

Provider.ID_1.description: Make this provider a copy of another provider with its own sign-in, such as `openai.work` with `openai`, so both accounts can be used at the same time

releaseDate.description: Release date as YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY-MM

defaultVariant.description: Variant used when the route is selected without an explicit variant.

variants.description: Remaps a route-level variant to this target's variant, e.g. { "low": "high" } runs this target at high when the route is selected at low.

until.description: Epoch milliseconds after which this target leaves the route. Used for time-limited pool membership; takes effect when the configuration reloads.

softLimit.description: Fraction of an allowance at which the target is passed over. Defaults to 0.9.

items.description: A weekday as a name or 0 (Sunday) to 6 (Saturday).

daysOfWeek.description: Weekdays the window is active on. Empty or unset means every day.

items.description: A day of the month, 1 to 31, or -1 for the last day of the month.

daysOfMonth.description: Days of the month the window is active on. Empty or unset means every day.

start.description: Local start of the daily window as "HH:mm". Unset means from the start of the day. A start later than the end runs past midnight into the following morning.

end.description: Local end of the daily window as "HH:mm", exclusive. Unset means to the end of the day.

timezone.description: IANA timezone such as "America/Chicago". Unset means the host's local timezone.

from.description: Epoch milliseconds before which the window never applies.

until.description: Epoch milliseconds after which the window never applies.

id.description: Name for the schedule, shown in decisions and editors.

targets.description: Target references this change covers, `*` allowed, e.g. ["deepseek/*", "openai/gpt-6-*"]. Empty or unset means every target of the route.

factor.description: Multiplies the target's configured weight while the window is active. 0.8 makes a weight of 2 become 1.6; 1.2 makes it 2.4. Exactly one of factor and weight is expected.

weight.description: Sets the target's weight outright while the window is active, instead of scaling it. Applied before any user preference for the target.

note.description: Why the schedule exists, kept for review.

targets.description: Ordered provider/model references. A route may include another route reference.

firstTokenTimeoutMs.description: Fail over if the target produces no response output within this many milliseconds. Defaults to 10000.

maxResponseTimeMs.description: Count a completed response as slow when it exceeds this many milliseconds, measured to the end of the model's response. Tools that the step runs afterwards do not count.

minOutputTokensPerSecond.description: Count a completed response as slow when output throughput, from the model's first output to the end of its response, falls below this rate.

sampleWindow.description: Number of completed requests in the rolling performance window. Defaults to 5.

slowThreshold.description: Slow requests in the window that mark a target degraded. Defaults to 3.

cooldownMs.description: How long a failed or degraded target is skipped. Defaults to 60000.

quotaCooldownMs.description: How long a target is skipped after the provider reports an exhausted quota without saying when it resets. A reported retry-after always wins. Defaults to 900000.

budgets.description: Allowances keyed by target model reference, e.g. { "openai/gpt-6-luna": { "requestsPerDay": 500, "tokensPerMinute": 200000 } }. Usage is counted from every request OpenCode makes to the target and is restored from history after a restart.

hedgeAfterMs.description: Send the same request to the next target when the current one has produced no output after this many milliseconds. The first to answer wins and the other is cancelled; nothing is shown or run before a winner is known. Costs a duplicate request whenever the first target is slow. Off by default.

attempts.description: Total requests to make against one target before failing over to the next, so 2 allows one retry. Defaults to 2. Retries only happen before any response output, so no tool call ever runs twice.

autonomy.description: How much the route may decide for itself; each level includes the ones before it. fixed: configured order with failover only. rules: adds selection modes, weights, budgets and provider rate-limit holds. adaptive: adds the scheduled review that skips or down-weights targets from recent history. predictive: adds time-of-day and error-text prediction. agent: adds route_stats and route_adjust so the model can inspect and steer routing. Unset keeps the behavior from before levels existed.

selection.description: How a session picks its target: ordered uses the configured order (default), round-robin rotates per new session, weighted draws by weights. Either way the choice is sticky for the session and failover falls through the remaining targets in order.

weights.description: Relative ratios for the weighted selection mode, keyed by target model reference, e.g. { "openai/gpt-6-luna": 3, "github-copilot/gpt-6-luna": 1 } sends about 3/4 of new sessions to the first target. Targets without a weight count as 1. A nested route is keyed as "opencode-route/<id>" and is chosen as one unit by this route; it then picks among its own members using its own selection and weights.

schedules.description: Time-bound weight changes for this route's targets, e.g. peak hours that make a provider lighter. Weights order every selection mode: inside an active window the targets are ranked by effective weight, and equal weights keep their configured order.

context.description: Caps the context limit the route presents, below every target's own limit — e.g. 100000 keeps sessions on this route inside a pricing tier that ends at 100k context, or compacts them earlier than the targets would. The effective limit is the smaller of this cap and the targets' minimum, so a cap can never raise a route above what its targets support.

limit.description: Limits the route presents as its own, regardless of its targets' limits.

Config.ModelRoutes.description: Named ordered provider/model routes with failure and performance failover

providers.description: Provider IDs the change covers, compared case-insensitively.

models.description: Model ID patterns the change covers, `*` allowed, e.g. ["*flash*"].

routes.description: Route IDs the change is limited to, including nested ones. Empty or unset means every route.

factor.description: Multiplies the target's configured weight while the window is active.

weight.description: Sets the target's weight outright while the window is active, instead of scaling it.
